patch.value: Stream certified native reads under caller resource limits
Embeddable bounded read sessions for non-Node hosts, reusing existing native query and output contracts.

Large synthetic trackers respect a declared memory ceiling; cancellation releases resources; wire results remain oracle-conformant; compact JSON/TOON, typed refusals and remedies, README and example; read-only non-git public-tracker validation; unchanged CI gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap audit: core SDK listAllComplete/certifyCompleteListResult own completeness and CLI list owns pagination. pm-context owns durable context packs and usage receipts; pm-web consumes complete SDK lists. Native pagination is pm-rust-ufzy and latency is pm-rust-wdj4. No existing embedding resource contract found. Reuse Workspace::list_page, strict decoding, lifecycle registries and JSON/TOON codecs. Add bounded private snapshot admission, cooperative cancellation and certified session receipts without another core query or parity pin. The crate remains native Rust; typed TypeScript is used for the validation harness.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation decision: immutable private disk snapshots isolate admitted reads from later writers while preserving original cursor identity. Admission accounts native working-set reserve and bounds every source read; the declared ledger ceiling is distinct from measured process RSS. Reuse canonical list_page, strict complete-item decoder and duplicate checks. Pull ownership supplies backpressure, cancellation is cooperative between copying/query boundaries, and completion/failure/cancel/drop remove snapshots. Add unchanged npm/Bun aliases for the existing Rust release gate and a Bun CI aggregate. Local work is restricted to targeted tests, lint/typecheck and focused validation because the host is saturated.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Initial CI and targeted regression found that the canonical output renderer returns an omission-only receipt for infeasible budgets rather than always raising an error. The embedding wrapper now refuses result_omitted before it can mark a session complete and cleans up the snapshot. Keep the canonical renderer unchanged. Also isolate fixture init with an explicit tracker path so linked-test sandbox environment cannot redirect initialization. CI aggregate thresholds remain unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Focused linked suites passed 7 SDK and 4 CLI regressions before the strengthened complete-source-deletion check. Public-oracle validation distinguishes SDK convenience envelopes from CLI envelopes: use the real SDK complete-list certificate and row comparisons, plus the existing published CLI launcher under a fixed clock for byte-exact page comparisons. Frozen sessions now load lifecycle registries from snapshot storage while retaining only cursor identity from the original tracker. Behavioral reverts are being verified independently; no release thresholds or oracle pins changed.

Restored linked suites passed 7 SDK plus 4 CLI tests; the npm/Bun aggregate wiring regression passed 1 test; formatting, strict Clippy, private rustdoc and strict erasable TypeScript checks passed. The public copy has 78 items and unchanged authoritative source hashes. Final large measurements and CI remain pending.

Preserve query-root spelling for ordinary registry reads, while sessions resolve registry storage to their private snapshot. Existing workflow_fallbacks_and_settings_errors regression detected this. Reclaim for the compatibility correction; thresholds remain unchanged.

value.text: CI run 39982597630 completed the regular and coverage-instrumented suites, then enforced unchanged thresholds and found one uncovered output-cursor branch, two lines and 30 error-propagation regions. Coverage review also identified a delivery invariant: completion/pages must update only after successful terminal cleanup, so a cleanup error cannot certify an undelivered final page. Reclaim for that correction and complete fault-path verification; keep all four coverage thresholds at 100.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Blocking review found that Path::exists suppressed schema lookup failures and allowed a session to certify defaults when the canonical list reader refused. Pulled the PR branch, merged advanced main and regenerated/checked the changelog inside the merge. Reusing this feature item for the correction: optional schema lookup will fall back only for NotFound, preserve canonical I/O path and error kind for other failures, and refuse admission before completion. Add a regular-file schema-parent regression and verify behavioral revert failure, targeted Rust tests, strict Clippy, and the unchanged npm/Bun CI aggregates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Fixed blocking schema lookup refusal by replacing the lossy existence check with symlink_metadata and an explicit NotFound-only default branch. All other lookup errors retain the canonical read-path spelling and original OS error in PmRustError::Io, refusing admission before any certificate. Regression schema_parent_file_preserves_canonical_lookup_error compares path, NotADirectory kind and raw OS code with list_page for default/configured statuses and configured workflows. CLI regression schema_parent_file_never_certifies_cli_completion verifies JSON/TOON refusal, empty stdout, unchanged source and removed private scratch storage. Behavioral revert proof: restoring only the original Workspace::read_session made the SDK regression compile and fail with exit 101, reporting that schema lookup must refuse before session certification. Restored fix passed all 16 SDK and 6 CLI session tests, also through both matching pm-linked commands; strict all-target/all-feature Clippy and formatting passed. Ten independent behavioral revert proofs now exist. Prior resource measurements are retained as explicitly identified pre-review observations; completed large-fixture work was not repeated. Read-only health found no pending merge receipt; existing local environment advisories were left untouched, with the clean CI gate required for full health evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review round: remote head pulled and already contains main. GraphQL reports zero review threads and no CodeRabbit review body. Failed CI run 40004446634 shows Windows canonical list treats a schema parent file as NotFound, while the regression incorrectly requires Unix NotADirectory. Preserve strict Unix refusal assertions and verify Windows canonical fallback parity explicitly. Recheck the blocking lookup fix with an independent behavioral revert, self-review the complete diff, and run the unchanged native release gate.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof repeated at this head: replacing only the optional registry lookup in Workspace::read_session with the previous exists() check compiled successfully and failed both cargo +1.90.0 test --locked --lib read_session::tests::schema_parent_file_preserves_canonical_lookup_error -- --exact and cargo +1.90.0 test --locked --test read_session_contract schema_parent_file_never_certifies_cli_completion -- --exact, each exit 101. SDK reported admission unexpectedly succeeded; CLI returned exit 0 instead of 2. Restored the exact production source. Focused restored suites pass 16 SDK and 6 CLI tests on Unix. The added Windows regressions check canonical default-registry parity and cleanup rather than requiring a Unix-only OS error. Whole-diff self-review covered schema path components, bounded source errors, snapshot isolation, completion/cleanup, output continuations, and CLI writer failures; no additional instance of the swallowed lookup defect was found.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Coverage self-review: the non-NotFound registry error must also be exercised on Windows, where the file-parent case is NotFound. Added a platform-independent real invalid-filename regression for statuses and workflows using a NUL path from settings; it compares the exact canonical InvalidInput refusal and rejects admission. This preserves error-branch coverage on every release platform without mocking filesystem behavior or lowering thresholds.
